page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, separated by a vertical rule. Left column: entries 1 to 8. Right column: entries 9 to 18. Printed page number at the top left, running head at the top of each column. No headings, no marginal notes, no catchword.

main_text.p: ירכך femur tuum, ירכה ejus, (fœminæ) ירכו ejus, (viri) ירכים femora, ירכך tua, f. m. constr. ירך, aff. & dual. aff. No. Rad. ירך femur.
ירכתו latus ejus, ירכתים latera bina, ירכתי latera, &c. f. fœm. aff. & dual. constr. No. f. fœm. ירכה ; à No. R. ירך.
וירם & jaculatus est eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. ירה.
וירם, וירם, וירם & extulit se, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. Rad. רום.
וירם et exaltavit, וירם et exaltabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. רום.
וירם et vermificavit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. רמם.
וירמו et elati sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. רמם.
ירמון exaltant se, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. רום.
ירנו acclamabunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. רנן.
ירננו cantabunt, fut. Piel 3. pl. m. R. רנן.
ירע malum erit, ירעו malè erunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. ירע.
ירע malum erit, fut. Kal, vel (qu. pro ירע,) malo afficiet) fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. ירע.
ירע malefaciet, ירעו malefacient, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. ריע [?].
וירע et vociferatus est, וירעו et vociferati sunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. ריע.
ירע confringet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. רעע.
ירעה illa fuit mala, præt. Kal, 3. f. fœm. R. ירע.
ירעוך pascent te, ירעון pascent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff.

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied from the scan with their vowel points, and the points are approximate, since the scan is small and blurred at many places. The consonants are the main reliable part. Doubtful: the page number and running head at the top, and the Rad. form in the entry "malefaciet" (marked [?]). The entries are set as lines of the printed lexicon, and no notes or headings are printed on this page.
